claims.title: FeMoCo ground-state energy resource estimate via spectral amplification and DFTHC (Low et al., 2025)
claims.headline: FeMoCo's ground-state energy could be estimated with about 3.2 million physical qubits in roughly 2.7 hours.

claims.title: FeMoCo ground-state energy resource estimate via Trotter-based phase estimation (Reiher et al., 2017)
claims.headline: FeMoCo's ground-state energy could be computed to 0.1 mHa in about 130 days with 111 logical qubits and 1.1 × 10¹⁵ T gates, or about 180 million physical qubits at a 10⁻³ error rate.
